facts.business: India Glycols Limited manufactures bio-based chemicals including glycols, ethylene oxide, ethanol, and specialty chemicals using sustainable raw materials like molasses and damaged rice.
key_risks: Regulatory and tax disputes including classification of RAB under Central Excise Tariff and transitional ITC claims
Dependence on bio-based raw materials availability and pricing
facts.related_party_note: Joint venture with Clariant IGL Specialty Chemicals Private Limited (49% share); transactions include sale/purchase of goods and services.
